rule.name: EpochNarrowedToInt
rule.message: An epoch time is cut to a 32-bit int here: epoch milliseconds overflow at once, and epoch seconds overflow in 2038 and turn a long lifetime into a date in the past. Keep epoch times in a long or an Instant (long expiresAt = Instant.now().getEpochSecond() + lifetimeSeconds), and compare them as long values.
